summary: Fretless bass: singing, smooth slides, neo-soul and fusion
label: fretless bass
body: Long notes with slides; melodic fills between phrases.

Register: MIDI 28-55 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Fretless Bass, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Fretless Bass") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
